title: One browser build everywhere
assertion: The web tests, the worker, the tools and the lockfile name one Playwright version (playwright-core one catalog line), and the worker image installs the lockfile's playwright-core with no version of its own; every step that installs the browser, in every workflow, is followed by the check that holds every file of the headless shell's and Chromium's builds to `browser.json`'s tree SHA-256s before any test runs or any cache is saved, and the worker image's headless shell is held to it in `images` and in the release's build before it is saved; CI regenerates the committed brand baselines from nothing, byte for byte, on every pull request and every push; a browser-tests pull request is red on the browser check by design until the baseline procedure runs, and its other steps still run
noFileReason: The manifests, the lockfile, the worker's Dockerfile and the workflows are read; the browser check runs on stand-in builds and a stand-in docker in a temporary directory, and the baseline step's script in a temporary git repository; no file.
